correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the forbidden layer to an exact identity. Oddness of the host and odd \(b\) force the host to be a square. If the host had exactly two prime factors, the second prime \(p\) satisfies \(p\ge S=\sigma(q^b)\). The minimal-layer identity forces \(p^{2a}\mid H=\sigma(q^{b+1})\), while \(p^{2a}\ge S^2>H\), an immediate contradiction. Each parity, divisibility, and inequality step was reconstructed independently; the finite verifier only regression-checks the symbolic proof.
